title: Module 9 quiz — Containers for Java
description: Eight questions on OCI images, registries, secrets, Java sizing, and hardening for BayPay payment-service. Synthetic only.

questions.prompt: What is an OCI image for BayPay, in one sentence?
choices: A running payment-service JVM
A layered, content-addressed filesystem plus config (entrypoint, user, ports) that Docker and Podman can both run
A WebSphere ND cell packaged as a tarball
A Kubernetes Service object
questions.explanation: Images are build artifacts. Containers are running instances. Docker and Podman consume the same OCI format.

questions.prompt: Why is eclipse-temurin:21-jre preferred over a full JDK in the runtime stage?
choices: JRE cannot run Spring Boot
The runtime image should not ship a compiler and extra attack surface; javac belongs in the build stage
Temurin cannot be pinned
OpenShift requires Ubuntu + apt openjdk
questions.explanation: Multi-stage: build with JDK/Maven, run with JRE. Smaller image, fewer tools in prod.

questions.prompt: A Dockerfile contains ENV BAYPAY_DB_PASSWORD=changeme-baypay. What is wrong?
choices: ENV is illegal in OCI
The secret is in the image history and every registry copy; supply it at runtime instead
Spring Boot cannot read ENV
Only Kubernetes Secrets can hold the letter P
questions.explanation: Image layers are forever. Use runtime env / Secret. FIX-902 class of defect.

questions.prompt: Why is :latest a production smell for registry.baypay.example/baypay/payment-service?
choices: Registries forbid the word latest
You cannot tell which bits run, rollbacks are guesswork, and two nodes may pull different images
Tags are not OCI
Avery Chen’s account UUID cannot be in a tagged image
questions.explanation: Pin a version or digest. latest moves.

questions.prompt: Container memory 512Mi and -Xmx512m on payment-service is wrong because:
choices: G1 cannot run in a container
RSS includes native, stacks, and metaspace; the cgroup kills the process when the heap already reserved the whole limit
Spring Boot requires 8Gi
Podman ignores cgroups
questions.explanation: Same rule as Modules 7–8. Use MaxRAMPercentage below 100 or an Xmx with headroom.

questions.prompt: Which USER line matches the BayPay image contract?
choices: USER root
USER 10001 (non-root numeric) after the process can bind 8080 without privileged ports
USER 0 so apt works at runtime
No USER — Kubernetes will invent one
questions.explanation: Non-root is the default. Port 8080 does not need root.

questions.prompt: Why copy pom.xml (and the wrapper) before source in a multi-stage build?
choices: Maven forbids copying Java first
Dependency layers cache until the POM changes; source changes then rebuild only the compile layer
It hides secrets
It enables SIBus
questions.explanation: Layer cache is the PERFORMANCE-904 point.

questions.prompt: Is “put BayPayCell DMGR in a container and call it modern” a valid Module 9 outcome?
choices: Yes; ND is the 2026 greenfield runtime
No; containers package the Boot/Liberty app; ND remains the source estate to leave
Yes if the image is Ubuntu
Only on OpenShift
questions.explanation: Do not lift the cell unchanged into Docker and stop. Image the payment process.
